answer: Each agent’s voting weight can be tied to a scarce, nontransferable deposit that is locked before a task and slashed if the agent is proven to have double-voted or violated a challenge rule. Creating a hundred fake identities then requires funding a hundred deposits, not merely generating names; the attacker also risks losing each stake and paying the opportunity cost of locked capital. A voyage through a nebula or a saffron-themed profile earns no extra weight: only bonded, accountable participation does.
